'''Bogoljub Marković''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|Богољуб Марковић}}; born 12 July 2005) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). Standing at {{height|m=2.10}}, he plays at the [[power forward]] position. He also represents the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia national team]]. In the [[2025 NBA draft]], Markovic was selected with the 47th pick by the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].

==Professional career==
In October 2023, [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] loaned Marković to [[OKK Beograd]] for the [[2023–24 Basketball League of Serbia]]. Over 28 regular-season games, he averaged 17.9 points, 9.1 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bogoljub Marković, OKK Beograd |url=https://kls.rs/igrac/?igrac=149&t=1714818259 |website=kls.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}}</ref> Marković was named to the All-First Team [[Basketball League of Serbia]] and was the leading rebounder of the regular season.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prvotimac plavo-belih Bogoljub Marković u najboljoj petorki lige |url=http://www.okkbeograd.org.rs/en/prvotimac-plavo-belih-bogoljub-markovic-u-najboljoj-petorki-lige/ |website=okkbeograd.org.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}}</ref>

On 26 April 2024, Marković declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Veliki talenat srpske košarke ide na NBA draft: Zablistao na Evropskom, bio prvi skakač domaće lige, sad gleda ka Americi |url=https://nova.rs/sport/kosarka/veliki-talenat-srpske-kosarke-ide-na-nba-draft-zablistao-na-evropskom-bio-prvi-skakac-domace-lige-sad-gleda-ka-americi/ |website=nova.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}}</ref> but later withdrew.<ref>{{cite web |title=31 early entry candidates withdraw from 2024 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/news/31-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-2024-nba-draft|website=nba.com|access-date=12 August 2024}}</ref> He was selected with the 47th overall pick  by the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] in the second round of the [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-select-bogoljub-markovic-with-47th-pick-in-2025-nba-draft|title=Milwaukee Bucks Select Bogoljub Marković with 47th Pick in 2025 NBA Draft|date=June 26, 2025|publisher=National Basketball Association|access-date=July 29, 2025}}</ref> He then joined the Bucks' summer league roster, where he averaged eight points, 2.2 rebounds, and four assists in five games.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Bogoljub Markovic just gifted Bucks fans a glimmer of hope
 |url=https://behindthebuckpass.com/bogoljub-markovic-gifted-bucks-fans-glimmer-hope
 |website=Behind the Buck Pass
 |author=William Moxon
 |date=November 2, 2025
 |access-date=April 25, 2026
}}</ref> After the Summer League conclusion, Markovic opted to return to Serbia and play for his former team, Mega Basket, with plans of becoming better so he can return to the [[NBA]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Bucks Draft Pick Bogoljub Markovic Will Return to Mega Basket for Next Season
 |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/bucks-draft-pick-bogoljub-markovic-return-overseas-serbia
 |website=[[Sports Illustrated]]
 |publisher=[[SI.com]]
 |access-date=April 25, 2026
}}</ref> Marković finished the season averaging 18.2 points, 2.5 assists, and a league-leading 9.1 rebounds.<ref name=bmmvp>{{cite web
 |title=Milwaukee NBA draft pick Bogoljub Marković wins Serbia's MVP award
 |website=Brew Hoop
 |url=https://www.brewhoop.com/bucks-news/65173/milwaukee-nba-draft-pick-bogoljub-markovic-wins-serbias-mvp-award
 |access-date=14 May 2026
}}</ref> On May 8, 2026, Marković won the [[ABA League MVP]] award and the Top Prospect Award.<ref name=bmmvp />

===Milwaukee Bucks (2026–present)===
On July 1, 2026, Marković signed a four-year, $9.3 million contract with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-bogoljub-markovic-to-a-multi-year-contract|title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Bogoljub Marković To A Multi-Year Contract|date=July 1, 2026|website=nba.com|access-date=July 1, 2026}}</ref>

==National team career==
Marković was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Serbian under-18 team]] that won the gold medal at the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship]] in [[Serbia]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 14.1 points, seven rebounds, and 1.7 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bogoljub Markovic 2023 FIBA Profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2023/player/Bogoljub-Markovic |website=fiba.basketball |accessdate=4 May 2024}}</ref> He was selected to the All-Star Five Team of the championship.<ref>{{cite web |title=Serbia star Topic takes home MVP award |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2023/news/serbia-star-topic-takes-home-mvp-award |website=fiba.basketball |accessdate=4 May 2024}}</ref>

On 24 November 2024, Marković made his debut for the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbian senior national team]] in a win against [[Denmark men's national basketball team|Denmark]] in [[Belgrade]] during the [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Marković: Velika čast raditi sa selektorom|url=https://www.zurnal.rs/sr/clanak/200842/kosarka/reprezentacija/markovic-velika-cast-raditi-sa-selektorom|website=zurnal.rs|access-date=27 November 2024}}</ref>
